summary: Master the art of KPI development with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the tools to measure and improve organizational performance.
lede: KPI development helps professionals responsible for performance measures translate objectives into clearly defined indicators, calculations, data sources, and ownership. Training covers distinguishing leading and lagging indicators, setting baselines and targets, and building a governed KPI dictionary, strategy map, and scorecard. It also develops skills in checking data quality, analysing variance, and linking performance reviews to corrective action and management decisions.
audienceIntro: This KPI development course suits professionals who define, analyse, govern, or act on organizational performance measures. It is especially relevant when you need to improve an existing measurement system rather than start with basic spreadsheet literacy.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software. Familiarity with Power BI is useful but not required, and the course does not require programming. The exercises use provided datasets and templates, so you can complete the core work without access to your organization’s systems.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
